title: Queen mate: bring the king close
objective: Use the king to support a final queen check on the edge.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original synthetic lesson
commentary_source.attribution: Original instructional text and synthetic queen-mate position

steps.explanation: The queen has trapped Black's king on the edge. Bring White's king closer before giving the final check.
steps.detail: Your king can guard the squares beside Black's king. Bring it close before the last check.

question.prompt: Bring the king closer, then deliver checkmate.
hints: Move the king from c6 to b6.
After ...Kb8, check on the back rank.

tree.feedback: Kb6 brings the king close enough to support the mating net.

children.feedback: Black has only Kb8. Now finish with a queen check.
Qd8# is checkmate. The queen checks across the back rank while the king covers a7 and b7.
Qh8# is checkmate too. The queen controls the back rank from the other side.

question.other_legal_move_text: That move may still win, but this exercise practises bringing the king close before the final check.

takeaway: Use your queen to make a small box for the other king. Bring your king close. Then give the last check.
